source_signature.text:
theorem exists_pureState_nonzero_on_star_mul_self [Nontrivial A]
    {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ phi : A →L[ℂ] ℂ,
      phi ∈ stateSpace A ∧ IsPureState A phi ∧ phi (star a * a) ≠ 0
